Satellite Images of Hurricane Damage (binary: damage / no_damage)
Public source: Hugging Face Datasets -- jonathan-roberts1/Satellite-Images-of-Hurricane-Damage
  https://huggingface.co/datasets/jonathan-roberts1/Satellite-Images-of-Hurricane-Damage
Original data: Post-Hurricane Harvey satellite imagery (IEEE DataPort / Kaggle mirror).

Usage in this study:
- Loaded the parquet "train" split (n = 10000, binary labels) directly via the
  Hugging Face datasets library; no local copy is redistributed here.
- Derived RCG/threshold-transfer results are in
  artifacts/derived/hurricane_rcg/ and artifacts/derived/immune/hurricane_immune.json.
